scope: All 884 actual intervening own executions since the one-time seed scan; not a repeated broad scan
limitations: Only eight registered local worktrees; other machines, unregistered checkouts and undocumented runs remain unknown.
Seedless files/records do not prove non-consumption; path/schema gaps retained.

Targeted metadata scanner covers experiments/logs/replays CSV and JSON, including gzip. Raw JSONL traces, rollouts and provenance are deliberately NOT reparsed; metadata/CSV coverage cannot establish freshness for missing or exclusively JSONL histories.

Supplemental text scan covers root/docs/scripts/experiments/logs/replays .md/.py/.sh/.txt/.log files, numeric literal mentions and explicit intervals. Computed seed formulas, unsupported schemas and opaque binary formats can escape detection.
Stored bytes deduplicated by SHA256 for structured formats; text content separately deduplicated.

Exactly two current ensemble-behavior paths (plan and spec) are allowlisted as these card reservations; every other matching text mention requires review. Historical 9960xxx training blocks are intentionally outside this scan. Any concurrent HEAD or observed file changes are recorded, not described as a freeze. Own script/results excluded.

No repository imports, model loading, tests or game execution; writes restricted to the two exclusive result files beside this external audit script. The CLI flag records operator acknowledgment, not independent proof of Root/Watcher approval.
